root.label: Reports on FIFA handling of Lionel Mpasi eligibility case

events.label: Reports on FIFA handling of Lionel Mpasi eligibility case

slots.name: Lionel Mpasi age
slots.sentence: The 32-year-old Mpasi was a France Under-17 international and never completed the FIFA process of switching his national eligibility to Congo where he has family ties, the reports said.

slots.name: Mpasi first call up year
slots.sentence: The New York Times and Le Monde cited internal documents from the investigation that FIFA disciplinary lawyers noted Mpasi did not have formal approval from the governing body when he was first called up to the national team in 2021.

slots.name: ineligible games count
slots.sentence: Yet Mpasi never was eligible to play in five games that took Congo to the World Cup and could have been forfeited under FIFA rules, the reports said Tuesday.
